name: Tenth District Sewers
description: The vast sewers beneath Ravnica's Tenth District where fatbergs have become immune to electrical magic.

timeline.summary: Leighbet, moonlighting as an analyst, follows the Golgari troll Kel'teth through the Tenth District sewers to find what is making fatbergs immune to electricity.
timeline.quote: No time for gawking, I'm afraid,
